acceptance.assertion: Evidence records the exact merged Commonworld commit, deployed release ID, production URL, physical Android model, Android version, Brave version, viewport orientation and relevant display or accessibility settings.

On the physical Android/Brave device in portrait, the digital sphere shows ring strokes and multiple non-empty readable ring labels, remains interactive, emits no uncaught page error and does not lose labels after globe drag, zoom or refocus.

On the same physical device in landscape with a CSS viewport wider than the compact 48rem breakpoint where available, the coarse-touch path remains active, primary and depth ring labels stay visible and the compositor regression does not recur.

If no defect is found, physical evidence is bound to the exact deployed release without product-code changes. If a defect is found, the exact remediation head passes focused Android regressions, full make validate, canonical browser smoke, required GitHub checks, merge, deployment and production readback before verification.

approval.note: Physical verification is read-only unless the deployed Android/Brave surface reproduces a defect. Any remediation must use an isolated Commonworld worktree and preserve exact release/evidence binding.

goal: Verify the Android digital-ring label fix from Commonworld PR #200 on a physical Android device in Brave against the exact merged and deployed release in portrait and non-compact landscape, and repair any device-only regression without reintroducing compositor-sensitive SVG parent motion.

does_not_establish: that Chromium emulation equals physical Android/Brave compositor behavior
that green CI proves production deployment
permission to re-enable compositor-sensitive parent animation without physical proof
metadata.observed_gap: Chromium automation proves 390x844 portrait and 844x390 coarse-touch layout, but a real Android/Brave readback of the deployed merged head is still required.
metadata.source: Follow-up from Commonworld PR #200 Android ring-label regression

rollback.strategy: If physical Android verification exposes a regression, retain the failing evidence and revert only any new corrective change that worsens label visibility, accessibility or desktop motion; the deployed static-label workaround remains the safe baseline until a proven replacement exists.

title: Verify ring labels on physical Android after deploy
